boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations clustered along East Campus Pointe Drive, the mixed-use corridor immediately east of Fresno State and the Save Mart Center.

cards.title: Pick a Film with Accessibility Options
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — sensory-friendly screenings and current releases
cards.notes: Check the Fresno showtime page, choose an age-appropriate film, and ask the box office about Maya Cares or available Care Rooms.
cards.short_summary: A 16-screen cinema with sensory-sensitive programming and family accommodations beside Fresno State.
cards.evidence_claim: Maya Cinemas lists its Fresno theater at 3090 East Campus Pointe Drive and advertises Maya Cares sensory-sensitive shows and Care Rooms.
cards.access_notes: Admission is ticketed; consult the theater’s Fresno listings for current showtimes, ratings, formats, and accessibility programs.

cards.title: Watch an Ice-Cream Creation Take Shape
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — made-to-order ice cream on a frozen stone
cards.notes: Choose a size and mix-ins at the counter, then watch the crew combine the ingredients on the shop’s frozen granite stone.
cards.short_summary: A clearly marked Campus Pointe dessert stop with customizable ice cream, shakes, and cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cold Stone’s official location page places Store #20732 at 3047 E Campus Pointe Drive and identifies its ice-cream, cake, shake, and smoothie offerings.
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; consult the official store page for current dine-in, pickup, and delivery hours.

cards.title: Compare a Mochi Doughnut’s Texture
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — mochi doughnuts and rice hot dogs
cards.notes: Browse the available doughnut flavors before ordering, and compare the ring’s connected segments with a conventional cake doughnut.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive doughnut counter highlighted in Fresno State’s Campus Pointe dining guide.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide identifies Mochinut as an off-campus dining option serving mochi doughnuts and rice hot dogs.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; confirm the destination’s current menu and operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Choose a Vietnamese Noodle Format
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — pho, vermicelli bowls, and rolls
cards.notes: Read across the pho, vermicelli, and roll sections, then select the format that fits the meal you want rather than guessing from photos.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Vietnamese destination with several clearly different noodle and roll formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide describes Wayside Noodles as family-owned and lists pho, rolls, and vermicelli bowls among its offerings.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; verify current hours and available dishes directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Build a Juice-or-Smoothie Break
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — organic juices and smoothies
cards.notes: Review the posted ingredient combinations, choose juice or smoothie texture first, and flag any dietary restrictions when ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Pointe cafe centered on fruit-and-vegetable drinks rather than a full restaurant meal.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe dining guide identifies Raw Earth Juicery and Cafe and states that it offers organic juices and smoothies.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; ask staff about current ingredients and allergens before ordering.

cards.title: Decode a Large Sandwich Menu
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — an extensive named-sandwich selection
cards.notes: Start with bread and dietary needs, narrow the long menu to a few candidates, and read each ingredient list before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich counter where the unusually broad menu makes comparison part of the visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide names Ike’s Love & Sandwiches and reports a menu containing more than 500 sandwiches.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; verify current hours, menu availability, and allergen information with the restaurant.

cards.title: Try a Korean-Fusion Preparation
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — Korean fusion dishes and house sauces
cards.notes: Compare the available proteins and preparations, ask how the sauces differ, and state your preferred spice level before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A named Korean-fusion destination whose menu emphasizes preparations paired with house sauces.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide identifies Bulldoc Korean Fusion and says its dishes are prepared with fresh ingredients and signature sauces.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; confirm current menu choices, spice levels, allergens, and hours directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Customize a Boba Drink
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — tea, smoothies, juice, and sweets
cards.notes: Choose tea, smoothie, or juice as the base, review the available toppings, and request a sweetness level that matches your preference.
cards.short_summary: A drink-focused counter offering several bases that can be paired with boba-style add-ons.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide names Sweet Lyfe Boba Bar and lists tea, smoothies, juice, and sweets among its offerings.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; check current hours and ask staff about caffeine, ingredients, and allergens.

cards.title: Assemble a Custom Pizza
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — personalized pizzas built from selected toppings
cards.notes: Select a crust and sauce, scan the topping line before committing, and build a combination that can cook evenly in one pass.
cards.short_summary: A counter-service pizza destination organized around choosing the components of an individual pie.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide identifies Pieology as a dining option and describes its pizzas as reflecting each customer’s selections.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; verify current crusts, toppings, allergen procedures, and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Compare a Cross-Cultural Taco Menu
cards.subtitle: East Campus Pointe Drive — Brazilian, Asian, and Mexican influences
cards.notes: Review tacos alongside the other formats, identify the listed cross-cultural ingredients, and ask staff about substitutions before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual taco destination documented for combining Brazilian, Asian, and Mexican food influences.
cards.evidence_claim: Fresno State’s Campus Pointe guide identifies Wahoo’s Fish Tacos and describes its food as a fusion of Brazilian, Asian, and Mexican fare.
cards.source_title: Campus Pointe — Fresno State Outreach and Special Programs
cards.access_notes: A purchase is required; consult the current menu and ask staff about ingredients, substitutions, and allergens.
